zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ bla ma'i mdzod spu nas ye shes kyi 'od zer dkar po byon nas/ rang gi lus la phog lus kyi sdig sgrib dag nas/ bum pa'i dbang thob par bsam/ yang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma rin po che'i gsung du dbang bskur bar mdzad du gsol/ ces lan gsum gsol ba gdab pas/ bla ma'i gsung las ye shes kyi 'od zer dmar po byon nas/ rang gi ngag la phog pas/ ngag gi sdig sgrib thod dag nas/ gsang ba'i dbang thob par bsam/ yang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma rin po che'i thugs la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gi yid kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa byang zhing dag nas/ yid smin grol rgyal ba'i thugs su dbang bskur bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes len gsum gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i thugs las ye shes kyi 'od zer mthing ka byon nas/ rang gi yid la phog nas/ yid kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag nas/ dbang gsum thob par bsam/ yang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma rin po che'i sku gsung thugs la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag nas/ rgyud smin grol mthar phyin nas/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs su dbang bskur bar mdzad gsol/ ces lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i sku gsum thugs kyi gsum nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum byon nas/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la phog pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med du gyur par bsam/ gnyis pa rtsa ba'i bla ma de 'od zer lnga'i tshul du gyur nas/ spyi bo nas rtsa dbu ma'i nang na mar byon/ snying pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa'i dbus kyi lte ba la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi ngo bo yig ge hūṃ mthing nag ye shes lnga'i 'od 'phro ba cig tu bsam/

de'i phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la/ oṃ traṃ hri a/ bzhi pa g.yas bskor du zhugs bar bsam/ mtshams bzhir/ laṃ taṃ/ laṃ taṃ/ bzhi g.yon bskor du bsam/ de'i phyi rol du rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa'i rtsibs rnams la/ bka' rgyud bla ma'i gsang mtshan dang*/ rtsibs 'chan rnams yi dam lha'i gzungs sngags rnams bkod la/ de lta bu'i 'khor bar dmigs shing*/ gsang mtshan gyi bsnyen pa 'di ltar bya'o// oṃ na mo rat+na gu ru/ badz+ra dh+ri ga hūṃ/ oṃ na mo rat+na gu ru/ pradzñā pha la hūṃ/ oṃ na mo rat+na gu ru/ dzñā na sid+dhi hūṃ/ oṃ na mo rat+na gu ru/ dharmā sid+dhi hūṃ/ oṃ na mo rat+na gu ru/ badz+ra ke du hūṃ/ oṃ na mo rat+na gu ru/ ma ti kirti hūṃ/ oṃ na mo rat+na gu ru/ badz+ra rā dza hūṃ/ oṃ na mo rat+na gu ru/ rat+na sīṃ ha hūṃ/ oṃ na mo rat+na gu ru/ girti bu ṇ+ya hūṃ/ oṃ na mo rat+na gu ru/ badz+ra rat+na hūṃ/ oṃ na mo rat+na gu ru/ dharmā rā dza hūṃ/ oṃ na mo rat+na gu ru/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes brjod par bya'o// de nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la dmigs nas/ rig pa ma yengs pa'i ngang nas/ longs sku'i gsol 'debs 'di ltar bya'o// oṃ āḥhūṃ/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi pho brang mchog /snying ka chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus// mi 'jigs seng ge pad+ma dang*// nyi zla nor bu'i gdan stengs na// rang gi sems kyi ngo bo'i rten// rtsa'i dngas ma yi ge hūṃ// dngas ma gsum gyi rang bzhin nyid// ye shes lnga'i 'od 'phro ba// de ni sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// rgyal ba rigs lnga he ru ka// dbyer med drug pa rdo rje 'chang*// thams cad 'dus pa rang gi sems/ rang sems bla ma rin po che// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku gsung thugs// lhun gyis grub pa'i tshul du bzhugs// rtsa'i dngas ma yi ge hūṃ/ hūṃ gi rnam pa bla ma'i sku// bla ma'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// zhe sdang dag par byin gyis brlobs// de dang dbyer med rgyu ba yin// zag med thig le bla ma'i thugs// bla ma'i thugs la gsol ba 'debs// 'dod chags dag par byin gyis rlobs// dngas ma gsum gyi bla ma la// sku gsung thugs kyi mos gus kyi// 'khyer so gsum du gsol ba 'debs// sgo gsum dag par byin gyis rlobs// yi ge hūṃ gi bla ma la// gnyis 'dzin med pa'i mos gus kyis// yengs pa med par gsol ba 'debs// rgyun chad med par byin gyis rlobs// nyams myong srog gi bla ma la// zhen chags med pa'i mos gus kyis// spyod lam rnam bzhir gsol ba 'debs// 'bral med 'khor lor byin gyis rlobs// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i bla ma la// sku gsum lhun grub mos gus kyis// mi zad 'khor lor gsol ba 'debs// 'gro don rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba btab cing don la mnyam par bzhag

/gsum pa de nas 'khor lo'i rtsibs 'chan gyi bla ma yi dam gyi gsang mtshan rnams// dbus kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma 'dus pa dang*/ bla ma'i sku las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs kyi rigs lnga'i sa bon la phog de las so sor kha dog dang 'od zer phyogs thams cad du 'phros pas// phyi nang snod bcud thams cad rigs lngar gyur te/ de dag tshur 'dus pa las/ so so'i sa bon la phog pas// sa bon rnams rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim nas// bla ma'i sku gsung thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang*/ rang gi sems phyag rgya chen po dang dbyer med pa'i don la mnyam par bzhag la/ yang gsol ba 'di ltar gdab bo// oṃ bla ma rang sems sangs rgyas gsum// gcig tu gyur pa'i ngo bos ste// skye 'gag gnas pa gsum dang bral// smra bsam brjod pa'i yul las 'das// lhun gyis grub cing gdod nas dag /gnyug ma ngo bo nyid kyis stong*// zab cing 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// thugs rje ye shes lnga dang ldan// yon tan phrin las thogs pa med// rtsol med 'gro don lhun grub/ rang sems bla ma rin po che// chos kyi sku'i sku gsung thugs// spros bral chos kyi dbyings na bzhugs// rig stong 'pho 'gyur med pa yin// don dam chos nyid bla ma'i sku// bla ma'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// gnyis su med par byin gyis rlobs// gsal stong zung du chud pa yi// gnyis med ye shes bla ma'i gsung*// bla ma'i gsung la gsol ba 'debs// tha dad med par byin gyis rlobs// bde stong zag pa med pa yi// lhan cig skyes pa bla ma'i thugs// bla ma'i thugs la gsol ba 'debs// dbye ba med pa byin gyis rlobs// rig pa gsal stong bla ma la// dngos gzung med pa'i mos gus kyi// gsal le sing nger gsol ba 'debs// sgrib g.yog med par byin gyis rlobs// skye 'gag bral ba'i bla ma la// rang ngo shes pa'i mos gus kyis// sgro 'dog chod par gsol ba 'debs// rtsa bral rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// snang ba sna tshogs bla ma la// dgag bsgrub med pa'i mos gus kyis// du ma ro gcig rtogs zung 'jug chen por// ye sangs chen po'i bla ma la/

blo 'das chen po'i mos gus kyi// dmigs pa med par gsol ba 'debs// dgos 'dod 'byung bar gsol ba 'debs// zhes gsol btab cing*/ yengs pa med pa'i brtson 'grus chen pos nyams su blangs pa nam dngos gzhi'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ thun 'tshams su bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis rgyas 'debs pa'o// spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la gsum mo// spyod lam rnam gzhi gang gi dus su yang*/ snang ba thams cad bla ma'i sku snang stong zung 'jug /grags pa thams cad bla ma'i gsung grags stong*/ dran rtogs thams cad bla ma'i thugs rig stong zung 'jug /'dor na sku gsung thugs kyi 'khyer so 'di rnams dang ma bral bar bya'o// de rnams ni thun drug gam bzhi la sogs pa nyams su len pa'i 'tshal lo// spyir na theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi bzhed kyi// bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi dbang thob phyin chad/ snang ba thams cad bla mar ma gyur pa gang yang med pas// 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug de rnams kyis sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sgo nas/ man ngag dngos bstan zin to/ spyir bla ma'i dbye ba la bzhi yin te/ phyi gdul bya ngor snang gi bla ma/ nang gsang sngags rang rgyud kyi bla ma gsang ba rang sems chos sku'i bla ma/ de kho na nyid snang ba sna tshogs kyi bla ma'o// snang ba sna tshogs kyi bla ma ni/ phyi snang ba dbang po lnga'i yul phra ba dang rag pa thams cad dang*/ nang yul nyon mongs pa'i rnam par rtog pa/ gsang ba na tsha dang cho 'phrul/ yid kyi spyod yul bde ba dang sdug bsngal thams cad drin can bla ma yin te/ ci'i phyir na/ la nyams su len pa'i gang zag brtson 'grus dang ldan pa rnams la/ snang ba sna tshogs su 'char ba 'di dag thams cad nyams myong gi gsal 'debs dang*/ sems nyid kyi ngo sprod du lhan 'char bas ni/ de bas lhag pa'i bla ma gcig logs na med pas/ bla ma zhes bya ste/ rje ti lo pas/ skye med ston pa'i slob dpon du/

snang ba dkar dmar shar tsam na/ shes pa bya rog gzings ltar thong*// 'dod yon spyod cig na mo pa// rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ 'drer 'dzin gyi rnam rtog rin po che// skye med kyi gsal 'debs ngo mtshar che// zhes pa dang*/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ bka' drin can gyi bla ma de/ bsod nams bsags pa'i snang bar shar/ zhes gsungs pas de'i don go bar bya'o// don go bar byas nas nyams kyi gsol ba 'debs 'di ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i gsol 'debs so// de ltar bla ma la/ phyi 'dul byar ngor snang gi bla ma la gsol ba btab cing mos gus byas la/ nang sngags rang rgyud kyi bla ma la mnyam par bzhag cing nyams su blang*/ gsang ba rang sems chos sku'i bla ma la nges shes bskyed cing*/ sgo 'dogs bcad cing mnyam par bzhag go// de dag thams cad kyi skabs su thun mtshams su snang ba sna tshogs kyi bla ma la bogs 'don pa gang shar bla mar shes par bya'o// de ltar nyams su len pa la// mos gus bla ma'i lam zhes bya'o// mos gus la bzhi ste/ phyi gdung ba'i mos gus ni/ gdung shugs 'don gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ nang du dmigs pa'i mos gus ni/ bla ma'i sku la dmigs pa ma yengs pa gtod pa'o// gsang ba mnyam bzhag gi mos gus ni bla ma'i thugs dang*/ rang gi sems gnyis phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du/ dbyer med du 'jog pa'o/ de kho na nyid rjes bskyong gi mos gus ni/ rjes kyi mos gus sems nyid kyi ngo bo nyid kyi ngo sprod du na lhan lhan shes par bya ba ni/ shin tu yang bcas pa'i mos gus te/ mdor na mos gus zhes pa ni/ bla ma rang sems dbyer med pa'i nyams myong*/ srog ces pa ni/ rang nyid nyams myong de rang gi srog yin pas/ srog ces bya'o// 'khor lo ces pa ni/ rang gi nyams myong de rgyun chad med par dgos pas na 'khor lo ces bya'o// de nas mos gus srog gi 'khor lo zhes bya'o// de ltar bzhis nyams su blangs na bla ma dam pa'i sku gsung thugs thob ste/

'gro don bla ma dam pi sku gsungs thugs dgyes par byed pa yin te mngon sum na gsal lo// de ni gzhi lam 'bras bu'am yin no// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i tshe gcig lus gcig gis sangs rgyas bar byed pa de lam zab mos gus la yod pa'o// e ma ngo mtshar mi che'am/ mos gus srog gi 'khor lo yi/ gsol 'debs nor bu'i phring ba 'di/ bdag gis sbyar ba'i bsod nams des/ rang sems bla ma'i don rtogs shog /'di nyid don dang 'gal ba dang*/ 'phrul par gyur pa ci mchis pa// mkha' 'gro rnams la bzod gsol nas// chos kyi dbyings su bshags par bgyi// dam chos 'di nyid ma thob cing*// don ma go ba gang zag gi// lag tu yi ge mi 'khyar ba// de ni 'di'i bka' rgya'o// bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsol 'debs dang*// sgom don zung du 'brel ba la/ rnam yid bzhin nor bu zhes// snang srid bla ma'i lam 'khyer 'di// shākya'i ldum bu rat+na'i ming can gyis// gangs ri'i bka' rgyal po te se'i lha mgul du// yi ge bkod pa 'di ni yongs rdzogs so// 'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig// /

༄༅// mos gus gsang ba 'dus pa'i yig chung bzhugs so/ rgyal ba rim brtsigs ngo bo cig pa la bsdus la/ ngo bo cig pa'i spyi'i oṃ las ye shes kyi 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ rang gi lus la phog lus kyi sgrib pa dag par bsam/ mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ rang gi mgrin par phog /ngag gi sgrib pa dag par bsam/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ rang gi snying gar phog rang gi yid kyi sgrib pa dag par bsam/ sku gsung thugs las byung ba'i 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum po de pad kyis chad nas byung bas dod rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la phog lus ngag yid gsum cha mnyam gyi sdig sgrib dag par bsam/ de rnams dbang bzhi'i ngo bo// gnas sa ga'u kha sbyor gyi man ngag ni/ rang gi 'og tu 'byung ba sa'i ngo bo rin po che gsare las grub pa'i 'khor lo/ ga'u'i ma khebs kyi dbyibs lta bu cig bsam la/ rang gi sting du 'byung ba nam mkha'i ngo bo rat+na dngul las grub/ ga'u'i kha khebs lta bu gcig bsam la/ de gnyis kha sgrigs pa'i nang du/ rang gi lus 'di dngos grub pa med pa'i stong pa nyid du bsam la/ ga'u'i ma gdan gyi dkyil du ma las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar skyil le gcig gi dbus su/ a dmar po'i mtha' ma na phar/ kā li dmar po sor bzhi g.yon skor du/ lcags bsregs kyi mdog lta bu dmar ram me bsgor nas yod par bsam/ ga'u'i ya khebs kyi dkyil du/ a lis zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba lta bu dkar skyil le ba cig gis dbus su haṃ dkar po'i mtha' ma na phar/ ā le dkar po nyis 'gyur du/ g.yas bskor du dung gi yi ge lta bu dkar ram me yod par bsam/ de gnyis kyi dbus su snying gi thad ka tsam du/ srog gi 'khor lo gzhung bzhin du bsam zhing*/ de'i dbus su hūṃ ye shes lnga ldan bsam/ de nas gzhung na yar srog shing gi tshul du/ rtsa dbu ma'i rnam pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/

sbom phra mda' gnyug tsam snang ba'i gzugs su grub pa la/ reg pa'i rdzas su ma grub pa/ mja'i rnam pa/ yar snang yar gyi haṃ la zug pa/ mar snang mar gyi a dmar po la zug pa cig tu bsam la/ de'i nang nas srog 'khor gyi dmigs pa dang*/ bsnyen pa byas pas/ hūṃ las ye shes lnga'i 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros pas/ ga'u'i nang thams cad 'ja' 'od kyi rnam pas khrig gis khengs par bsam la mnyam par bzhag rje thun mtshams su rang gi lus su dkrongs kyis gyur pa las/ ga'u'i ya khebs zla ba'i dal/ a li dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas/ spyi bo'i haṃ la thim/ ga'u'i ma khebs nyi ma'i dal/ kā li dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas/ lte ba'i a la thim pas/ srog 'khor gyi dmigs pa las ma yengs pa'i ngang nas/ gsang ba ye shes mchog gi gsol 'debs dang*/ nam mkha' dbyings kyi gsol 'debs la sogs pa man ngag las 'byung ba rnams nyams su blang ngo*// de ltar nyams su blangs pas/ sgo gsum la bar chad mi 'byung ba dang*/ dmigs pa gsal zhing mos gus la bogs thon pa'i dgos pa yod do// nges don sku gsung thugs la sbyor na/ lus yi dam gyi lha snang stong zung 'jug tu sgom pa ni/ ā li kā lis ngag gi bar chad bsrung ba yin la/ de tha mal du song ba'am/ sgra grags stong ya bral ba'am/ rlung rig dbyer med du ma shes na a li ma yin te/ ngag bar chod kyi dbang du song ba'o// yid bla ma'i thugs rang rig stong zung 'jug tu sgom pa ni// 'od zer gyis yid kyi bar chod bsrung ba yin la/ tha mal du song ba'am/ rig stong ya bral na 'od zer ma yin te/ yid bar chod kyi dbang du song ba'o// des na sku gsung thugs kyi 'khyer so// zung 'jug gsum po yid la gnas nas/ tha mal dang*/ ya bral gyis bar ma chod par byas nas/ mchod pa rgyun du 'bul bar bya'o/ gsung ngo*/ i thi/ oṃ āḥn mo rat+na gu ru/ sku gsung*/ badz+ra dhā ra sid+dhi pha la hūṃ/ phyag 'tshal lo/

oṃ āḥn mo rat+na gu ru/ rdo rje 'chang*/ dngos grub stsol/ pradzñā shes rab bzang po pha la sid+dhī hūṃ/ oṃ āḥn mo rat+na gu ru/ dzñā na sid+dhī ye shes dngos grub pha la hūṃ/ oṃ āḥn mo rat+na gu ru/ dharmā mati mar pa chos kyi blo gros pha la hūṃ/ badz+ra dhā mi la rdo rje rgyal mtshan dza/ pu ṇ+ya rat+na rgan po pa bsod nams rin chen/ badz+ra ra dza/ rat+na shri/ 'bri gung pa rin chen dpal/ kirti saṃ grags pa 'byung gnas/ rat+na badz+ra rin chen rdo rje/ kīrti dzñān grags pa ye shes/ kirti dh+wa dza/ kīrti pradzñi grags pa rgyal mtshan/ grags pa shes rab/ kirti bo dhi grags byang chub/ pu ṇ+ya ki rti bsod nams grags pa/ shrī man kī rti dpal ldan grags pa/ dharam kīrti dzñā na shrī bha dra chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po/ siṃ ha dhā dza rtogs ldan seng ge rgyal mtshan/ rat+na ku ma ra ānan+da ku ma ra rin chen gzhon nu kun dga' gzhon nu/ dharmā shrī bha dra chos dpal bzang po/ oṃ āḥn mo rat+na gu ru/ 'di dang bri gung rin chen yan gong dang 'dra'o/ pu ṇ+ya kirti sid+dhī pha la hūṃ dbon po bsod nams grags/ badz+ra kīrti sid+dhi pha la hūṃ/ gcung rdo rje grags/ rat+na sing ha sid+dhi pha la hūṃ thog kha ba rin chen seng ge/ kīrti pu ṇ+ya sid+dhī pha la hūṃ/ mtshams bcad gcad pa bsod nams/ badz+ra rat+na sid+dhi pha la hūṃ rdo rje rin chen/ pu ṇ+ya bha dra sid+dhi pha la hūṃ/ brgyad pa bsod nams bzang po/ dharmā ke tu sid+dhī pha la hūṃ/ chos rgyal mtshan/ sing ha ke tu sid+dhi pha la hūṃ seng ge rgyal mtshan// // / ༄༅// bcu chos gsum chos dang zab chos kyi chos skor rnams tshang bar bzhugs pa lags so// no mo rat+na gu ru/

bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams gus par phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs so// de la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo gyur pa bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos rin po che byed pa la/ rang nyid stan bde ba la 'dug la/ mdun du ras la sogs pa'i steng du/ dmar gtor gsum/ dkar gtor gcig bgegs gtor cig dang lnga bya/ gzhan yang tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i yo byad dang*/ spos me dang bur chu la sogs pa sta gon bya/ slob dpon la phyag rten btang*/ phyag len gsum dang gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ de nas rang rang gi stan la 'dug te/ de nas thugs bskyed mdzad/ de yang bdag dang bdag cag thams cad la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes bar du gcod pa'i mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad ma yin ang snyam du bsam/ yul 'di na gnas pa'i gnas po chen po bzhi bdag byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang*/ bdag gi ma yin ang snyam du bsam/ ma 'di dag gis gtso byas pa'i nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ myur du bla na med pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du/ so so'i thugs dam la mnyam par bzhag de la skabs 'di'i thugs dam bgyi ba de/ tshad med pa'i snying rje chen po las skyes pa'i byang chub sems las skyes pa bskyed pa'i rim pa/ yi dam gyi lha la mnyam par bzhag nas/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa bgyi ba dag tu che ba mi brjod par/ yid kyis ge le 'grang bar zhu/ zhes spong la skabs 'dir gtor ma la chab bran/ gong ma bzhi la zur bsngos byas la/ bgegs gtor bsngos la btang*/ de na gu gul bsregs/ bur chus phyag mchod byas la/ tshogs byin gyis brlabs la drang*/ de nas lhag gtor bsdus la bsngos/ de nas sems can gyi don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya/ de'i ched du zab dang rgya che ba'i chos nyan cing nyams su blang snyam bsam/

de la bka' rgya med pa'i chos thun dang po ni/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags ral gri'i so dang 'dra bas/ ral gri'i so la dang po nas lag gis 'jus na/ lag pa gcod pas na/ 'ju su yu ba tshol ba dang 'dra ba lta bu yin/ cig par na 'di las zab pa gzhan logs na yod pa ma yin/ de la slob dpon chen po ti lo pa de/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po dngos yin bgyi ba'am/ dngos kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yin bgyi ba la sogs pa dpag tu med pa gsung kyang*/ dngos yin/ 'dzam bu gling du nub gcig la yang sprul pa bye ba brgya phrag 'gyed pa la sogs pa/ che'i yon tan dpag tu med pa de la/ rje btsun chen po nā ro pas ni lo bcu gnyis kyi bar brten bka' ba rnams pa bcu gnyis ni spyad/ de ma gtogs pa'i gdams ngag bla mas kyang thun gcig kyang ma stan/ slob mas kyang ma zhus/ de la nyin cig gi dus su/ nā ro pa khyod la sang ni gdams ngag dang rjes su gnang pa yang bstan par bya'o// gsungs pa la/ nga la do'i nub mo dgyes drags nas gnyal yang ma yin/ de'i phyir de nang par gyis dus su rje btsun chen po ti lo po de thang mi che ba cig gi dkyil na bzhugs 'dug pa la/ dpal nā ro pas thang de la byon pas thang de la chod dus ma byung*/ mya ngan gyi thang yin nam yang ma shes/ bla mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i thang yin nam yang ma shes/ de las drung du sleb pa'i dus su/ nā ro pa maṇ+ḍal phul gdams pa dang rjes su gnang ba bstan par bya gsung ba dang*/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'i chu yang phyogs na med/ me tog yang phyogs na med pa la/ sku lus phug pa'i khrag gis chag chag ni btab/ snyen bcad pa'i tshom bu bkod nas phul ba dang*/ slob dpon chen po te lo pa de seng ge ltar 'gyings nas gsungs pa/ dang po rtsa ba'i tshig gnyis bstan pa ni/ dngos po'i gnas lugs lam dang ni/ 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o// de la lus dngos po'i gnas lugs dang*/

sems dngos po'i gnas lugs gnyis las/ de la dang po lus dngos po'i gnas lugs ni/ lus ni byang chub sems dang ni/ mi gtsang rdzas dang rnam rtog gis/ lus kyi chos su gnas pa yin/ de la rdo rje'i lus 'di gdod ma nyid nas byang chub la lnga'i ngo bor byang chub/ de la dang po chos nyid stong pa nyid las byang chub/ gsung yi ge las byang chub/ gdan pa dang zla las byang chub pa/ thugs phyag mtshan las byang chub pa/ sku yongs su rdzogs pa las byang chub pa dang lngas byang chub pa lnga'i ngo bor byang chub/ de la dang po chos nyid las byang chub pa ni/ tshe lnga ma nas 'dir 'phos pa'am/ 'di nas pha rol tu 'pho ba'i dus su/ tshe 'di'i rnam par rtog pa ni 'gags/ phyi ma ma skyes pa'i bar dor bar do'i 'od gsal bgyi ba/ yar gyi mtshams med dang mar gyi mtshams med ma gtogs la/ spyin par gyi nyi ma lta bu cig skyes dgu kun la 'char ba yin/ de chos nyid stong pa nyid las byang chub bgyi ba dang po yin/ de nas chu la nya 'phar ba'am/ chu bur rdol ba'i tshul du/ rnam par shes pa phyir ldang ba ni/ gsungs yig 'bru las byang chub bgyi ba gnyis pa yin/ de nas phor skye zhing phor skye ba'i las bsags pa yin/ ma la chags shing pha sdang bas/ pha'i gshang lam nas zhugs nas khu ba dang 'dres nas 'bab/ mor skye zhing mor skye ba'i las bsags pa yin na/ pha la chags shing ma la sdang pas/ ma'i gshang lam nas khrag dang 'dres nas 'bab/ de ltar pha ma gnyis kyi khu khrag gnyis dang*/ bar do'i rnam par shes pa de chu dang 'o ma bsres pa de nang du khrug gis 'dres pa ni/ gdan nyi zla las byang chub pa bgyi gsum pa yin/ de nas phor skye zhing phor skye ba'i las bsags pa yin na/ gsang ba'i rdo rje sngon la chags pa yin/ mor skye zhing maur skye ba'i las bsags pa yin na/ pad+ma bha ga sngon la 'chags pa yin/ de ni thugs phyag mtshan las byang chub pa bgyi ba/ byang chub pa bzhi pa yin/

de nas mer mer po dang*/ gor gor po dang*/ ltar ltar po dang 'phrang 'gyur nya'i rnam pa la sogs pa rims kyis chags nas/ de nas rkang lag dod nas/ zla ba dgu ngo bcu ni/ mgo thur la bstan nas 'byung ste/ mngal gyi khru ma chos kyi tshul du byas/ lag pa thal mor sbyar ba'i tshul du byas/ pha mkhan po dang*/ ma slob dpon gyi tshul/ ngag tu a haṃ zhes chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi sgra sgrogs shing 'byung ba ni/ sku yongs su rdzogs pa las byang chub pa bgyi ba/ byang chub pa lnga pa yin/ des na lus ni byang chub rnam dang*/ rtsa dang byang chub sems dang ni/ mi gtsang rdzas dang rnam rtog gis/ lus kyi chos su gnas pa yin/ bgyi ba gsungs pas/ de nas rdo rje'i lus 'di la rtsa rgyas par phye na stong phrag bdun bcu don gnyis/ sdus par gyur na ngo bo drug bcu rtsa bzhi/ de bas kyang bsdus par gyur na/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi'i bdag nyid du gnas pa las/ rtsa dang bgyi ba rtse de rnams kyi nang nas khams byang chub sems kyi thig le/ dkar dmar 'gyus pas na byang chub sems dang ni bgyi ba gsung*/ mi gtsang rdzas dang rnam rtog gis/ lus kyi chos su gnas pa yon/ bgyi pa gsungs pas/ spyir rdo rje'i lus ni mi gtsang ba'i rdzas sum cu rtsa gnyis las grub pa/ de dang rnam par shes pa chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa bzhin du gyur nas/ des na mi gtsang rdzas dang rnam rtog gis lus kyi chos su gnas pa yin/ zhes gsungs pas/ dpal nā ro pa'i thugs la chud/ sems dang dngos pa'i gnas lugs de nyin ma bstan/ nyin cig gi gnas skabs su/ nags mi che ba cig gi gseb tu dpon slob gnyis skyo sangs la byon pas/ dpal nā ro pa'i thugs la/ lus dngos po'i gnas lugs ni bla mas kyang legs par bstan/ bdag gis kyang khong du legs par chud/ sems dngos po'i gnas lugs ji lta bu yin thugs la skyes pas slob dpon te lo pa de zhal phyir bcu mdzad nas/

kye ho/ 'di ni rang gi ye shes te/ ngag gi lam 'das yid kyi spyod yul min// te lo nga la ci yang bstan du med// rang rigs nyid la shes te byos/ te lo pa'i chos drug ni/ mi mno/ mi sems/ mi spyad/ mi sgom/ mi bsam/ sems ni yang dag nyid du grol/ zhe gsungs pa dang*/ sems dngos po'i gnas lugs yang rtogs shing khong du chud pa la/ des na dngos po'i gnas lugs lam dang ni/ bgyi ba lam gyi rim pa la/ yi ge brgya pas sdig sgrib sbyang bar byas nas/ nyams len bdun gyi bar du lta ba lam gyi rim pa yin/ de nas logs bton nas phyag rgya chen po btag pas/ dang po rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor rgyud la skye/ de nas spros bral dang*/ ro gcig dang sgom med kyi bar du skye bas na/ 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o// bka' rgya med pa'i chos thun dang po'o// 'di gling blangs byed kyang byas pas chog /'on kyang zab mo'i chos la skur pa gdab tu med gsung*/ yang zab pa dang rgya che'i chos nyams su blang snyam du bsam/ bcu chos gsum chos bgyi ba 'di yin pas/ mi bcu bcu la gnang bas bcu chos/ gsum gsum la gnang bas gsum chos bgyi ba yin/ de na mchod kyi chos la bka' yang shin tu dam/ yar bla ma dang slob dpon la yang mi 'chad/ mar slob ma su thod thal yang mi 'chad/ rang nyid kyis yi ge brgya pa nas khrid byas/ phyag rgya chen po ngo sprad pa ma gtogs su la yang mi bstan/ yi ger yang mi 'bri/ dam tshig nyams nas dmyal bar 'gro/ dang po chos rje rin po ches dge ba'i bshes gnyan dar ma bla ma la gnang*/ gser srang gang la khral byas nas thud rkyal gcig la tshogs 'khor byas nas gnang*/ phyis kyi dus nor can ma gtogs pas/ snyom chung rnams kyis mi thob par 'dug dgongs nas/ bcu chos la bzhi nam/ gsum chos sum nas zho phyed tsam du phab nas mdzad pa yin 'dug /de la dang po rtsa tshig gnyis la/ de la rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbang du rnam par rtog pa tshur 'dus na/

'gro ba gzhan rang gi dbang du tshur 'du/ de la yang phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par bzhag pa'i ngang nas/ rnam par rtog pa gang yang rung ba cig thal skyes nas/ skyes pa de kha rgyud la phar shor na/ rnam par rtog pa'i dbang du rnam par mi rtog pa phar shor bas na/ rang nyid 'gro ba gzhan gyi dbang du phar 'gro/ de yang phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par bzhag pa'i ngang nas/ dper na 'dod chags kyi rnam par rtog pa lta bu gcig thal skyes na/ skyes pa de skye med phyag rgya chen po de nyid du chu la chu bzhag pa'am/ mar la mar bzhag pa bzhin du dbyer med du nyams su blangs pas rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbang du rnam par rtog pa tshur 'dus te/ skyes bu 'dod chags can ji snyed cig yod pa de thams cad bye'u chu la rub pa lta bur tshur dbang du 'du/ yang phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par gzhag pa'i ngang nas/ dper na 'dod chags kyi rnam par rtog pa cig thal skyes na/ skyes pa de kha rgyud kha rgyud la shor na/ rnam par mi rtog pa rnam par rtog pa'i dbang phar shor nas/ rang nyid skyes bu 'dod chags can cig gi dbang du phar 'gro/ de'i 'dod chags spyod pa'i grogs ngan 'ba' zhig byed par 'gyur/ yang phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par bzhag pa'i ngang nas/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang dang nga rgyal dang gti mug dang phrag dog la sogs gang skyes kyang phyag rgya chen po de nyid kyi ngang du chu la chu bzhag pa'am/ mar la mar bzhag pa bzhin du nyams su blangs pas de rnams kyang tshur dbang du 'du/ yang phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par bzhag pa'i ngang nas/ zhe sdang gti mug dang rgyal yin/ phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par bzhag pa'i ngang nas/ rang nyid 'khor dang bcas pa'i nang du skyon sna tshogs sna tshogs pa bskyed/ de nyams len gyi dbang du byas nas/ lam gtong nas nyams su len dgos pas/ da de la 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug la sogs nyon mongs pa bsam pa gang skyes kyang*/

lam du gtong dgos pas/ de la phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par bzhag pa'i ngang nas/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags lta bu cig thal skyes na/ rnam par rtog pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par rtsir gyis bzung nas/ bdag gis nyon mongs pa 'dod chags 'dis bdag dang nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa 'dod chags kyis gtso bor byas pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa shes bya'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag par gyur cig snyam du lam du gtang*/ de nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed yi dam gyi lha bsgom/ bla ma dam pa bsgom/ phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par bzhag /sngo bas rgyas gdab/ nyams len la lnga ldan gyi sting du lam stong bsnon pa yin/ de yang phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par bzhag pa'i ngang nas/ byams pa'i rtog pa lta bu thal skyes na kha rgyud kha rgyud du phar shor skyes bu byams pa dang ldan pa'i dbang du phar 'gro/ song yang nyes pa chung ste/ rnal 'byor pa yin na tshur dbang du 'du dgos pas/ yang phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par bzhag pa'i ngang nas/ byams pa lta bu cig thal skyes nas de ma thag tu lam du btong ste/ bdag gi byams pa'i 'dis sems can thams cad kyang tshad med pa'i byams pa chen po dang ldan par gyur cig snyam lam du btang*/ snying rje la sogs pa yang des 'dre/ lar dge ba'i rnam par rtog pa gang byung yang ldan par gyur cig ces lam du btang*/ mi dge ba'i rnam par rtog pa gong byung yang*/ dag par gyur cig ces lam du gtang*// lam btong la lag rjes rnam pa drug yin/ nyon mongs pa'i rtog pa'i can zhabs drung du yod pa'i dus su/ zhe sdang can yin yang bdag gi drung der phyin pa la/ zhe sdang gi 'khrul pa long bskyed snyam pa 'ong*/ 'dod chags can yin yang rang yang tshul khrims mi bsrung*/ gzhan yang 'dod chags la sbyor snyam pa'i rtog pa 'ong*/ nga rgyal can la sogs pa de 'dre/ lan du btang ba'i lag rjes kyis/

lo tsam 'gyangs sam/ zla tsam du slebs pa'i dus su/ bsam pa bzang por lam gyis 'gyur nas yong*/ 'dod chags can yin yang*/ rang yang tshul khrims bsrung ba dang*/ gzhan yang tshul khrims bsrung ba'i grogs bya snyam du bsam pa bzang por lam gyis 'gyur 'gro/ nga rgyal la sogs pa yang des 'dre/ de lam btong gi lag rjes yin/ byang chub mchogatu sems bskyed pas/ thams cad byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa'o// yi dam gyi lha bsgoms pas rigs mchol bas yin na/ yon tan rang nyid kyis bskyed kyang*/ tshan gcig nga la su gcig mo drin che/ ming gi mo drin che zer ba 'ong*/ de slob ma'i skyon yang a cing che te/ rang nyid yi dam gyi lha sgom yun thungs pa'i skyon yin/ bla ma snying gi dkyil du sgom yun ring du sgoms pas bla mas byin gyis brlabs cing thugs la 'dogs yong*/ yang tshan gcig rgyu mtshan chen po med par bla mas thugs rjes 'dzin pa de yang*/ bla ma snying gi dkyil du sgom yun ring pa'i yon tan yin/ tshan cig la mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes btsug byas kyang*/ de tshod las med pa de/ bla ma snying gi dkyil du sgom yun thung pa'i skyon yin/ des na bla ma snying gi dkyil 'khor du bsgoms na bla mas byin gyis brlob cing thugs la 'dogs gzhung rtag tu'i nyams len phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par bzhag pas/ bar do med par rdzogs sangs rgyas/ rjes dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba byas pas/ thams cad byang sems kyi rgyu 'bab zhing tu 'gro/ des bcu chos lnga ldan gyi lam rjes dang*/ bcas pa tsha ra ba yin/ yid bsngo ba re mdzad yang zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos nyan pa nyams su blang snyam du bsam/ da gsum chos tshangs par spyod pa'i man ngag bgyi ba 'di la/ bla ma gcig yod pa de mi'i bla ma ni men/ de la rtsa tshig rnam pa lnga yin/ rten gyi gang zag ci lta bu/ de lta bu gcig gi nyams len yin/ 'di'i dus su rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti dang*/

byang chub sems dpa' dga' byed gnyis kyi lo rgyus yang gsung*/ de yang rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti 'khor dang bcas ba grong khyer shaṃ bha la'i pho brang gi steng na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa nam mkha' la bzhud pa gzigs nas/ nang blon pa de la su yin byas dris pa la/ nang blon pa na re/ nang blon pa na re/ 'di yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa ri bo gangs can la blon nas/ da lha lhor bzhud pa yin zer skad 'o na 'dir spyan drangs na 'byon nam byas pas/ gdugs tshod dang gdan khri la sogs pa bshams nas gsol ba btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dgra bcom pa lnga brgya dang bcas pa rgyal po'i pho brang du byon pas/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pas gdugs tshod bsnyen bkur rgya chen po mdzad nas/ chos zhus pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis nyon mongs pa spangs pa'i chos gsungs pa dang*/ rgyal po dang nas/ lum pa'i tshal ni nyams dga' bar/ wa nyid seng ger gyur kyang ni/ 'dod pas spangs pa'i thar pa de/ gau tam nam yang mi 'tshal lo// gsungs pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis nyon mongs pa mi spong bar sangs rgyas pa'i chos/ skad cig denyid la bcom ldan 'das gsang ba 'dus par zhal bstan/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad pas rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti 'khor dang bcas pas nyams su blangs pas mkha' spyod du bzhud do// des na rten gyi gang zag de lta bu lags/ dam pa'i chos gang yin na/ dga' ba rnam pa bzhi yin/ de la dang po dga' ba/ mchog tu dga' ba/ dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba bzhi yin/ 'bus kyis bsdus na/ bde ba'i stobs chen po de dam pa'i chos yin/ de la nyams su blangs pa'i tshul gsum las/ lam du btang ba'i man ngag bde chen byang chub sems kyi man ngag /theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi man ngag dang gsum las/ de la 'di nyon mongs pa 'dod chags can gyi chos yin/

'dod chags nam skyes pa'i dus su/ lam btang ste bdag gi nyon mongs pa 'dod chags 'dis/ bdag dang nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi nyon mos ba 'dod chags kyis btso byas pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa shes bya'i sdig sgrib thams cad par gyur cig snyam du lam bdun nam lnga'am gsum gyi bar du lam du btang*/ de lam du btang ba'i man ngag bgyi ba de yin/ de ltar lam du btang bas lam btong gi ngo bo rgyud la skyes pas/ phyi yul la dmigs pa'i nyon mongs ba rgyud la mi skye/ nang du bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin thug pa med pa skye/ bde de las skyes pa'i byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ bde chen byang chub sems kyi man ngag bgyi pa yin/ sems bskyed de las yang skyes pa'i bskyed rim yi dam lha la mnyam par bzhag pas/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi man ngag dang gsum ste/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas/ de la sgrib pa ci tsam cig spong na/ las dang nyon mongs pa shes bya'i sdig sgrib thams cad rtsa ba nas spong dgos/ 'bras bu gang thob nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang dngos thob/ sum chos tshangs par spyod pa'i man ngag tshar ba yin/ bsngo ba gcig mdzad/ da 'di yan chad kyi chos la tshogs 'khor yang sha'i tshogs 'khor dgos/ chos thun re la gtor chung re dgos/ bka' rgya ya shin tu dam/ ri khrod la 'gro ba'i rtsigs su bzung nas gnang ba yin/ da de la sems can gyi don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya/ de la zab pa dang rgya che ba'i man ngag nyan cing nyams su blangs snyam du bsam/ de la spyir rdo rje'i lus 'di la rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi'i bdag nyid du gnas pa la spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo dang bzhi ru gnas pa la/ de la skyes bu kun gyi gshis sam lugs kyis/ mchog tu yang mi rnams kyi gshis sam lugs kyis/

rkang pa'i mthil gnyis kyi rgyu khugs kyi mthil 'di na las kyi rlung bgyi ba cig yod gsung*/ las kyi rlung de me rlung yin/ de de nas gnas na tshe ring ba dang phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'byung*/ dper na me thab na gnas pa nam 'dod pa'i dus su bus pa chog pa dang 'dra/ de de nas gnas 'phyugs na ngan te/ de thab nas 'phyugs na khang pa la sogs bsreg pa dang 'dra bar/ de la nyon mongs pa lnga'am gsum la sogs pa che drags/ spyad drags na/ las kyi rlung de bros pa bzhin du lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor 'pho/ 'phos pa'i dus su yang phyi nang gsum gyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gsum 'byung*/ nang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/ gsang ba rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang gsum 'byung*/ de la phyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/ rang nyid mo gdon bsen mo gci gi bdag byed/ des dgye dgye dbang med/ dgu dgu dbang med/ phyi rol gyi mo ma dang thangs pa la sogs pas bltas kyang*/ mi 'di la mo gdon bsen mo cig gis byas 'dug zer ba yong*/ khong la yang phyogs re'i tig tig 'dug gsung*/ de phyi rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba/ nang rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba 'dod chags kyi stobs chen po skye/ 'dod chags chen po'i go ba rmangs nas med pa ma yin te/ gnyen po mi chud pa'i 'dod chags skye/ chags pa spyod pa'i yul cig 'dug na/ pha ma'am bla ma la sogs pa'i mdun du yang spyod snying 'dod pa la sogs pa'i/ gnyen po mi tshud pa'i 'dod chags skye ste/ de nang rten 'brel bar 'byung ba/ gsang ba rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/ las kyi rlung de lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor 'phos pa'i stobs kyis de ltar du 'byung*/ de ltar phyi nang gsum gyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gsum phyogs gcig tu 'grig nas/ rtag pa mtha' gzung gi dbang du song na/ lo gsum song ba dang snying ga chos kyi 'khor lor 'pho/

'phos pa'i dus su yang rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba/ de la phyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/ mi gdon bsen mo des rgyal 'gong 'dug pa can cig la cig gis gtod/ des dgye dgye dbang mi ster/ dgu dgu dbang mi ster/ phyi rol gyi mo ma la sogs pas bltas kyang*/ mi 'di la rgyal 'gong gdug can cig gis bdag bcar byas 'dug zer ba yod/ lha rjes sman nag gi gtam brgyud yod/ de phyir rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yin/ nang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ni/ zhe sdang gi stobs chen po skye ste/ gsang ba rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba las kyi rlung de snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo 'phos pa'i stobs kyis de ltar 'byung ngo*/ de ltar phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gsum phyogs gcig tu 'grig nas rtag pa mtha' bzung du song na/ lo gsum song ba dang*/ 'grin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lor 'pho/ 'phos pa'i dus su yang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gsum 'byung*/ phyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba 'di/ rgyal 'gong gdug pa can des btsan gdug pa can cig la bcar gyis gtod/ btsan gdug pa can des bdag car gyis byed/ de phyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/ nang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/ phrag dog gi stobs chen po bskyed/ rang bas bzang zer na bla ma'am/ pha mas la sogs ba bzang zer yang mi bzod pa 'ong*/ rang bsam mtho zer na shing gi yal ga mtho zer yangabacog snying 'dod pa'i phrag dog chen po skye/ de nang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/ bsang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ni/ las kyi rlung de 'grin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lor 'phos pa'i stobs kyis de ltar 'byung ba/ de ltar phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gsum phyogs gcig tu 'grig nas/ rtag pa mtha' gzung du song na lo gsum song ba dang*/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor 'pho/

'phos pa'i dus su yang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gsum byung*/ de la phyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/ nang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/ gsang ba rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba ste gsu/ de la phyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ni/ btsan gdugs pa can des/ klu gdug pa can cig la cig gis gtod/ des dgye dgye dbang med/ dgu dgu dbang med/ des phyis rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ni/ nyon mongs pa gti mug chen po skyes te/ gti mug chen po'i go ba ni sngar nas med pa ni ma yin yang*/ mnyan po mi chud pa'i gti mug skye/ sngar nas chos dang chos ma yin pa shes// bya ba dang bya ma yin pa shes pa la/ phyi chos dang chos ma yin pa'i mi shes/ bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa'i ma shes par/ mun rub la/ mgo gtum pa bzhin 'gro/ de nang rten 'brel bar 'byung ba/ gsang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ni/ las kyi rlung de spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo slebs pa'i mthus de ltar 'byung*/ de ltar phyi nang gsung gsum gyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gsum phyogs gcig tu 'grig nas/ rtag pa mtha' gzung du song nas lo gsum te bcu gnyis ni mdze pho ri tsam gcig yod/ des na bsgrub pa nyon mongs pa dang bsre mi nyan/ nyams len gyi dus su ser zhugs pas lan/ yid kyis bsngo mdzad/ chos thun gcig yin/ yang zab dang rgya che ba'i chos nyan cing nyams su blangs snyam du du bsam/ gzhung rtag tu'i nyams len phyag rgya chen po yin/ de la mnyam par bzhag pa'i ngang nas rtag par rtog pa skyes/ skye phyis byed/ skye ba'i ltas spun rtser byung dus su de la bsdam bya dang sdom byed gnyis yod/ bsdam bya 'khor lo bzhir 'jug pa'i rlung de sdom byed sdom la rnam bzhi'am/ phyagargya bzhi'i rgyas gdab/ de ci lta bu yin na bong bu lta bu'i srog chags phra'u re'i steng du ri'i rgyal po ri rab bzhag na/

'gul rgyu med pa dang 'dra bar/ de thog mar dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i sdom pas gdams pas/ phyag rgya gdab pa de la/ yer pa zhang btsun dang khams pa lung pa'i gtam rgyud yod/ de nas nges par nyon mongs pa spong ba'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pas bsdams zhing phyag rgya gdab/ de la jo gdan 'jam mdzes dang*/ lo tsa ba rin chen bzang po dang*/ mgon po mi 'khrugs pa gsum gyi gtam brgyud yod/ de nas tshad med pa'i snying rje chen po las skyes pa'i byang chub kyi sdom pas bsdams zhing*/ phyag rgyas gdab/ de la chos rje rin po che'i gtam rgyud yod/ de nas dbang rnam par dag pa las byung ba'i bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi gdams pas gdams/ phyag rgyas gdab/ 'di'i dus su slob dpon pad+ma'i gtam rgyud yod/ yid kyis bsngo ba mdzad/ yang za pa dang rgya che ba'i chos cig nyan cing nyams su blang snyam du bsam/ da de ltar sdom pa rnam bzhi'am/ phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab nas nyams su blangs pas bsam pa rnam par dag pas rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba/ de la phyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ni rnal 'byor pa de la de bzhin gshegs pa sprul pa'i sku'i grags pas gang bar 'byung*/ slob mas bstod pa byed pa'am/ glu mkhan glu len pa'am/ sdang po yon slong ba rnams kyis kyang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprul pa sku'i bstod pa 'ba' zhig byed/ de phyis rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba nang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprul pa sku ji snyed yod pa zhal lta/ chos zhu zhing kun tu rgyu zhing*/ mgon po 'jam dbyangs bzhin du 'gyur/ gsang ba rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba sdom pa rnam pa bzhi'am/ phyag rgya bzhis rgyas btab nas nyams su blangs pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa de/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo stobs su gyur pa'i mthus de ltar 'byung la/ yang phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung gsum phyogs gcig tu 'grig nas rtag pa mtha' dag gzung du song na/

da phyis snga ma las zlog pa'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gsum 'byung ba/ phyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi sku'i grags pas gang ba 'byung*/ bstod pa byed rnams kyis kyang de ltar byed/ de phyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yin/ nang rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba/ chos kyi sku ji snyed cig yod pa zhal lta ba la sogs pa 'byung*/ de nang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yin/ gsang ba rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ni/ gsang ba rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ni/ bsam pa rnam par dag pa de snying ga chos kyi 'khor lor stobs su gyur pa'i mthus de ltar 'byung la/ de ltar rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gsum phyogs gcig tu 'grig nas rtag tu pa mtha' gzung du song na/ lo gsum song ba dang*/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lor 'phos pa'i dus su yang*/ da phyi snga ma las zlog pa'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gsum 'byung*/ de la phyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i grags pas gang ba byung*/ bstod pa byed pa yang kun gyi de ltar byed do// de phyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yin/ nang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ji snyed yod pa zhal lta/ chos zhu/ zhing nas zhing du rgyu zhing*/ mgon po 'jam dbyangs bzhin du 'gyur du nang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yin/ gsang ba rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/ bsam pa rnam par dag pa de mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lor 'phos pa'i mthus de ltar 'byung la/ de ltar phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba phyogs gcig tu 'grig nas rtag pa mtha' gzung du song nas/ lo gum song ba dang*/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor/ 'phos pa'i dus su yang*/ nga phyi snga ma las zlog pa'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gsum 'byung*/

de la phyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/ rnal 'byor pa de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i grags pas gang ba 'byung*/ slob mas bstod pa byed pa'am/ glu mkhan glu len pa'am/ sprang po yon slong ba rnams kyis kyang*/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i bstod pa 'ba' zhig byed par 'gyur/ de phyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/ nang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku ji snyed gcig yod pa zhal lta/ chos sku/ zhing nas zhing du rgyu zhing*/ mgon po 'jam dbyangs bzhin du 'gyur/ gsang ba rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba sdom pa rnam pa bzhi'am/ phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdam nas nyams su blang ba'i mthus/ bsam pa rnam par dag pa de spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor 'phos pa'i mthus de ltar 'byung ba/ de ltar phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rten cing 'brel pa gsum phyogs gcig tu 'greg nas/ rtag pa mtha' bzung du song na/ lo gsum te bcu gnyis na grub thob ri'i rgyal po ri rab tsam yong*/ sems nyid ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ mgon po phag mo grub pa lta bu yong*/ de la dgongs nas chos rjes kyang sems nyid ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ zhes bstod pa yin/ rnal 'byor pa de la tshol gnyen po med/ gdul bya la gnyan po med/ 'khor longs spyod la gnyen po med/ gdul bya yod par gyur nas bal pa nas bskal pa'i bar du bzhugs kyang rang dbang cha med par gyur na nyin gcig las mi bzhugs/ yang rang dbang che/ de la mgon po phag mo gru pa tshogs nas yar byon khar/ sgom ma cig gis 'brum bu gcig dang do le gcig khyer nas/ khyed 'di la 'dam mam 'di la 'dam/ sgrub pa nyon mos pa dang 'dres na mdze pho ri rab tsam gcig 'dam/ de bzhin du sgrub pa nyon mongs pa dang ma bsres par grub thob mgo rgyas cig la 'dam/ des na phye ma de la 'dam dgos gsung*/ yid kyis bsngo ba mdzad gsung*/

yang zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos nyan cing nyams su blangs snyam du bsam/ de la da res kyi 'di rtag pa'i chos thun yin/ da sngar gyi mdze bo ri rab tsam pa de 'dra ba ci byung na/ gnas 'di dang 'di rnams su sha ro yong*/ de la sha ro yong ba'i rgyu mtshan/ rkang pa'i mthil gyi rgyu khugs kyi rlungade me rlung yin/ de nyon mongs pa 'dod chags la sogs pa ha cang yang ches drags sbyang dra pas/ me rlung de gnas 'chugs/ gnas gar 'chugs pa'i sar/ rnams kyi rtse mo bsregs/ sne mo gar bsregs pa'i sar/ khams byang chub sems kyi theg le mi 'drongs la/ thig le gar ma 'drongs par lus la sha ro 'ong*/ de la dang po rkang pa'i brang ba'i stod de ru sha ro yong*/ der sha ro byung na 'bral ba'i dkyil der sha ro yong*/ brang pa'i smad du sha ro yong*/ der sha ro byung na smin mtshams su sha ro 'ong*/ rkang pa'i mthe bong gi rtsa ba'i 'bur de la sha ro 'ong*/ de la sha ro byung na mkhur ba'i bya skong la sha ro yong*/ rkang ba'i rgyu khugs la sha ro yong*/ der sha ro yong na mig kha 'ong*/ mig gis chu mi thub pa yong*/ rkang ba'i bol gong du sha ro 'ong*/ dar sha ro byung na kha la yong*/ kha skyog po la sogs pa 'byung*/ rkang ba'i long mo'i nang du sha ro yong*/ der sha ro byung na/ sna sdeb kyi nang du 'ong*/ der byung na long mo'i phyi logs su sha ro 'ong*/ der sha ro byung na/ sna steb kyi logs su 'ong*/ g.yas g.yon 'dra'o// rkang pa'i rting mchu la sha ro 'ong*/ der sha ro byung na mig mchu la 'ong*/ gsang ba'i rdo la sha ro 'ong*/ der sha ro byung na sna la yong*/ sna 'tshub pa la sogs pa 'ong*/ de nas phar 'ched 'tshur 'ched la song nas/ smin ma byi ba la sogs pa thun skra yang 'byi/ mdze pho'i lus su 'gro/ ma smad gsum gyi gtam rgyud yod gsung*/ yid kyis bsngo ba mdzad/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos nyan cing nyams su blangs snyam du bsam/

da sngar gyi mdze pho ri rab tsam pa de 'dra ba cig byung na/ thabs yod dam med na/ thabs kyang shin tu dka'/ 'on kyang snying rus chen bag tsam yod gsung*/ lo bcu gnyis kyi rgyags bsags nas 'tshams dam par spyad/ sgrub pa grogs dang mthun par bya/ de la dang po lam btang yun ring du bya/ de nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ yid dam gyi lha sgom/ bla ma dam pa lte ba'i 'og tu sgom/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas gser gyi rdo rje che ba lci ba cig gsham lam na mar song nas/ sa'i 'og na mar la nam mkha' thugs pa med pa mar la sir ri song bar sgom la/ de ltar bsgoms pas phan mi phan lo gsum shes 'ong*/ lo gsum na ska yan chad kyi dum bu 'di snum lam gyis 'gro/ de ma byung na phyi ma'i don bya/ kha chems chos dang mthun pa bzhag/ rked pa yan chad snum lam gyis byung na/ de nas snying gi man chad tsam de nas lte ba yan chad tsam snum lam gyis yong*/ ji ltar mchi yang lo bcu gnyis na phan yong*/ grub thob cig yong ste sngar gyi de 'dra mi 'ong*/ rang skyong tsam yong*/ gsum chos 'khor lo mtshar ba yin/ chos thun lnga yod kyi bsngo ba mdzad do// yang zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos nyan la nyams su blangs snyam bsam/ de la 'khor lo lnga ni/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags 'jigs su rung ba'i las sbyor yin gsungs/ de la spyir rdo rje'i lus 'di rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga'i bdag nyid du gnas pa las/ de la spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo/ bcad tshig sbas pa'i 'khor lo dang lngar gnas pa las/ de la sdod cing sdod pa'i 'khrul 'khor 'ba' zhig byas pa'i dus su/ sems kyi rgyal po de lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo na gnas/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags skye/ nyal ba dang nyal ba'i 'khrul 'khor 'ba' zhig byas pa'i dus su/ sems kyi rgyal po de gcad tshig sbas pa'i 'khor lo na gnas/

nyon mongs pa nga rgyal bskyed/ langs pa'i 'khrul 'khor 'ba' zhig byas pa'i dus su/ sems kyi rgyal po de snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo na gnas/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags skye/ nyal ba dang nyal ba'i 'khrul 'khor 'ba' zhig byas pa'i dus su/ sems kyi rgyal po de mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo na gnas/ nyon mongs pa phrag dog skye/ 'chong ba dang*/ rgyug pa dang*/ kus 'debs pa dang*/ dga' ba'i 'khrul 'khor 'bigs byas pa'i dus su/ sems kyi rgyal po de spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo na gnas/ nyon mongs pa gti mug bskye bgyi ba gsung*/ chos thun gcig yin/ yid kyis bsngo ba mdzad/ yang zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos nyan cing nyams su blang snyam du bsam/ da de ltar sdod cing sdod pa'i 'khrul 'khor 'ba' zhig bya/ lo'am zla ba'am/ bskal pa'i bar bgyi ba gsung na yang*/ 'dod chags ma skyes pa'i bar de tshad yin/ nam skyes pa'i dus su skong bu dro dus su phyi ma'i man ngag yin/ skong bu me'am nyi mas dros pa'i dus su/ grag pa yod pa'i dri ma yang dug po la sogs pas phyis pa sing gis 'gro ba dang 'dra bar/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags nam skyes pa'i dus su/ lam du yang cag gis gtang*/ de nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ bla ma dam pa dang phyag rgya chen po la sogs pa rgyas gdab/ pha gsad pa'i lag dmar thang stong la byung ba 'dra bar bgyi ba yang*/ de la da 'us dgra sha len par 'dod na/ kho ma khar btsan po gcig yod pa'i dus su/ phyi rol nas 'thab stangs dang*/ 'dug bstangs dang kha po dang ho di ra ji snyed cig byas kyang da 'us dgra sha mi lon/ kho rang bzhin gyi thang la byung yang yong*/ thabs kyis 'khrul 'khor la rten na yang rung*/ de'i dus su lag stabs gcig gis 'gro ba dang 'dra bar nyon mongs pa 'dod chags yang dpe gnyis po ltar lam du gtong dgos/ bsngo ba'i bar du nyams su blang*/

nyal ba dang nyal ba'i 'khrul 'khor 'big bya/ lo'am zla ba'am/ bskal pa'i bar bgyi ba gsung na yang*/ zhe sdang ma skyes kyi bar de tshad yin/ zhe sdang nam skyes pa'i dus su/ dpe gnyis po ltar zhe sdang lam du gtong ba dang*/ bsngo ba'i bar du nyams su blang*/ 'gro ba'i 'khrul 'khor 'big bya/ lo'am zla ba'am/ bskal pa'i bar gyi bgyi ba gsung na yang*/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo phrag dog ma skyes kyi bar de tshad yin/ phrag dog nam skyes pa'i dus su/ dpe gnyis po ltar phrag dog lam du gtong ba nas/ bsngo ba'i bar du nyams blang*/ 'chong ba dang*/ rgyug pa dang*/ kus 'debs pa dang dga' ba'i 'khrul 'khor 'big bya/ de ltar byas pas spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor nyon mongs pa gti mug skye/ nam skyes pa dang skong bu dro dus su phyi ma'i man ngag pha gsad pa'i lag dmar thang la byung ba dang 'dra bar/ dpe gnyis pa ltar lam du gtong ba nas/ bsngo ba'i bar du nyams su blang*/ de nyams len lnga ldan gyi steng du lam gtong bsnon pa yin yid kyi bsngo ba mdzad/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos nyan cing nyams blang mnyam du bsam/ da sdod cing sdod pa'i 'khrul 'khor la brten nas/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor 'dod chags lan lam du gtong ba nas bsngo ba'i bar du nyams su blang pas/ de la 'dod chags med pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag ba 'di/ bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med dngos yin bgyi ba gsung*/ bde ba can gyi zhing khams su bgyi ba phyi rol na med/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo de rang yin/ rnal 'byor ba de la mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa'i che ba'i yon tan ji snyed cig yod par 'byung*/ rlung lnga'i dbang du byas na yang*/ me dang mnyam du rgyu ba'i rlung la dbang thob/ zad par zil gnon gyi dbang du bgyis na yang*/ zad par me'i ting nge 'dzin la dbang thob/ gcad tshigs sbas pa'i 'khor lo nga rgyal lam du btong ba dang*/

bsngo ba'i bar du nyams su blangs pas/ nga rgyas med pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa de/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po rin po chen 'byung ldan dngos yin/ zhing yang lho phyogs na med de rang yin/ rnal 'byor de la mgon po rin chen 'byung ldan gyi che ba'i yon tan ji snyed yod pa 'byung*/ rlung lnga'i dbang du byas na thur sel dbang thob/ zad par zil non gyi dbang du byas na yang*/ zad par sa'i ting nge 'dzin la dbang thog langs pa'i 'khrul 'khor la rten nas/ snying ga chos kyi lo 'khor lo/ zhe sdang lam du btong ba nas bsngo ba'i bar du nyams su blangs bas/ zhe sdang med pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa ste bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa dngos yin/ zhing yang mngon par dga' ba'i zhing bya ba phyi rol na med/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo de rang yin/ mgon po mi 'khrug pa'i che ba'i yon tan ji snyed pa de la 'byung*/ rlung lnga'i dbang du byas na srog 'dzin pa'i rlung la dbang thob/ zad par zil gnon gyi dbang du bgyis na yang*/ zad par chu'i ting nge 'dzin la dbang thob/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo 'gro ba'i 'khrul 'khor la rten nas/ phrag dog lam du gtong ba nas bsngo ba'i bar du nyams su blangs pas/ phrag dog med pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa de/ bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa dngos yin/ zhing yang de rang yin/ rnal 'byor ba de la bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa'i che ba'i yon tan ji snyed cig yod pa 'byung*/ rlung lnga'i dbang du byas nas gyen du rgyu ba'i rlung la dbang thob/ zad par zil gnon gyi dbang du bgyi na/ zad par rlung gi ting nge 'dzin la dbang thob/ 'chong ba dang rgyug pa'i 'khrul 'khor byas pa la brten nas/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor dpe gnyis po ltar gti mug lam du gtong ba nas bsngo ba'i bar du nyams su blangs pas/ gti mug med pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa de bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad dngos yin/

zhing yang dbus zhes pa bya ba phyi rol na med/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo de nyid yin/ rnal 'byor pa de la bcom ldan 'das rnam par dag par snang mdzad kyi che ba'i yon tan ji snyed cig yod la 'byung*/ rlung lnga'i dbang du byas na/ khyab byed kyi rlung la dbang thob/ zad par zil gnon gyi dbang du bgyis na yang zad par nam mkha'i ting nge 'dzin la dbang thob bgyi ba gsung*/ mdor na 'khrul 'khor rnam pa lnga la brten nas/ nyon mongs pa lnga slang nas/ dpe gnyis po ltar lam du btong ba nas bsngo ba'i bar du nyams su blangs nas/ rkang dang*/ spris dang chu rgyus la yang gnas pa'i gnas pa nyon mongs pa thams cad dag nas rgyal ba rig lnga la che ba'i yon tan ji snyed cig yod pa de la 'byung*/ 'khor lo lnga mtshar ba yin/ yid kyis bsngo ba mdzad/ yang zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos nyan cing nyams su blang snyam du bsam/ de la zab chos rtsa rlung ma/ chos drug gsar ma 'di gnyis/ chos rjes kyi rin poche min pa/ bu slob su la yang ma gnang bar 'dug spyir rdo rje'i lus 'di rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi'i bdag nyid duganas pa la/ de spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo dang bzhi yin/ de la rtsa'i dbang du byas na/ rdo rje'i lus 'di la rtsa rgyas par byas na/ stong phrag bdun bcu don gnyis/ sdus par byas na gtso bo drug bcu rtsa bzhi/ de bas kyang bsdus na/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi'i bdag nyid du gnas/ de la rtsa g.yas pa g.yon pa dbu ma gsum yin/ rlung gi dbang du byas na/ nyin zhag phrugs gcig la/ nyi khri chig stong drug brgya sna nas rgyu/ de la phyi ring du rgyu ba/ nang du thung du rgyu ba/ de la thig le'i dbang du byas na/ skyes pa rnams kyi dkar po/ bud med rnams kyi dmar po/ 'khor los rgyal po dang bu thu bo yi sngon po/ de la rgya gar gyi mkhan po rgyud sde'i bdag nyid can rnams kyis kyang rtsa de rtsar 'chad rlung de rlung du 'chad/

thig le de lig ler 'chad/ bod kyi mkhas pa rgyud sde'i bdag nyid can rnams kyis kyang de ltar 'chad/ rgya bod gnyis ka'i ku su lu pa rnams kyis kyang de ltar sgom/ de la rtsa de rtsa rang ma yin/ rlung de rlung rang ma yin/ lte ba man chad gyi dum bu rtsa g.yon pa/ dkyil gyi dum bu rtsa dbu ma/ rtsa de rtsa yin gsung*/ rlungade rlung rang ma yin/ 'o na nyin zhag gcig la nyi khri chig stong drug rgya rgyu ba de rlung rang ma yin/ rkang pa'i mthe bong 'gul bar rang rtsa yin/ lag pa'i rkyang skum gcig gis/ mig dbyed 'dzum gcig gis/ rlung de rlung yin gsung*/ de la rgya gar gyi bla ma dur khrod pa bya ba gcig gis/ khyed bod la grub thob gar yod/ rlung la go ba med par gsung*/ bla ma 'bri khung pa des bag tsam go ba yod par 'dug gsung*/ chos rje'i thugs la/ bla ma dur khrod pa rang gis kyang go ba'i gzhung med par dgongs pa byung gsung*/ de las lus kyi 'gul skyod byed tshang rlung gis byed pa yin gsung*/ des na/ rlung zhes bya bas las kun byed/ 'di ni rnam shes gzhon pas te/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsung*/ thig le de thig le rang ma yin gsung*/ dkar dmar sngon gsum la sogs pa de thig le ma yin gsung*/ 'o na thig le gang yin na/ 'dod chags kyi sems kyang de rang yin gsung*/ de chosathun dang po yin/ yid kyis bsngo ba mdzad/ yang zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos nyan cing nyams su blang snyam du bsam/ de la da res kyis 'di rtsa rlung thim le gsum ka'i nyams len yin/ de la 'khrul 'khor thang la phebs par bya/ lag pa mnyam bzhag gam dbus mo la bkal na/ ro stod dgye log byas pa'i dus su/ rlung sems thams cad lte ba'i 'og tu lha na 'gro/ de yan chad gtan mi gnas/ 'di steng rlung rang gnas su gnon pa'i man ngag bgyi ba yin/ rgyu mtshan 'di yin/ slob ma slob par byed pa'i dpe la/ ston par byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yang 'di yin/

'khrul 'khor de bas dgu tsam phyag rgya chen po 'debs pa'i dus kyi 'khrul 'khor tsam bya/ de ltar byas pas/ rlung sems snying gar cig gis 'ong*/ yan chad man chad gang la yang mi gnas/ de yis mi rtog pa'i rlung rang gnas su mnon pa'i man ngag yin gsung*/ de de bas 'khrul 'khor dgu na rlung sems ske yan du 'du bas/ tshe thung*/ nad mang*/ longs spyod dbul/ bkra mi shes pa'i rtsa ba yin/ sgom pa'i dus su yanu ta ra'i khrod/ 'pho ba sgom pa'i dus la sogs pa min par mi bya/ de nas g.yas pa spang bar bya ba'i rtsa yin/ de dbu ma bskyed par bya ba'i rtsa yin/ da snying gi dkyil du rab bla ma/ 'bring yi dam/ tha ma yang sha po bsgoms kyang*/ la gcad pa'i gsung yin/ tha na rdo 'byong gcig bsgom kyang snying gi dkyil du nyams kyi dri ma dang bral ba'i ting nge 'dzin skye ste/ chag chag gi dpe de yin/ de mtshan nyid pa la sogs pa mi gus pa'i rten gyi gang zag la/ dang po nas bla ma snying gi dkyil du sgom pa mi ston par gsang ba yin/ snying gar sgom byas pas snying gi phyi shin tu bsgom par yong*/ de mi rtog pa'i nyams 'thug po cig skye/ de nas snying gi dkyil du bsgom pa 'dod kyis ston bgyi ba gsung de thig le gang yin na 'dod chags kyang pa de yin pa de yod dgos/ sgrub dgos/ bsgrub par byed pa la/ sgrub thabs kyi yan lag lngas bsgrub dgos/ de la gnas kyi sgrub pa/ dus kyi sgrub pa zas kyi sgrub pa/ rdzas kyi sgrub pa/ grogs kyi sgrub pa la lnga yin de la gnas kyi sgrub pa la gangs dkar ti se'am/ la phyi chu bar/ 'phan yul gnas chung ngam/ rtsa ri'am/ de lta bu na 'tshe'u re re yang 'jig rten pa'i mkha' 'gro ma 'bum 'bum gnas bgyi'am/ gzhan yang gdan sa rin po che yang lha dbang phyug chen po'i rten khyad par can yod/ de lta bu'i gdul bya yod pa'i sa na/ 'dul byed kyi ston pa bde mchog 'khor lo'i lha tshogs bzhugs pas/

de rnams kyi grib pa ma/ byin rlabs kyis bde ba skye ba yin/ de gnas kyi sgrub pa yin dus kyi sgrub pa la/ lo gcig la yang bcom ldan 'das kyi dus mchod chen po bzhi'i/ zla ba gcig la nya stong bzhi'am/ zhag gcig la yang thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor sgom pa'i dus su/ de dus kyi sgrub pa yin/ de rdzas kyi sgrub pa yin/ rdzas kyi sgrub pa la/ rdzas dngos po dag blta/ kham chung yang tha na khab skud yan chad/ mthong ba dang*/ sems dga' ldan song ba de la bsten nas skye ba yin/ dngos po ma dag pa'i rigs tsho kham che yang*/ skyobs na phar la sbas nas 'jog pa yin/ de rdzas kyi sgrub pa yin/ da zas kyi sgrub pa la/ tshan cig bcud len byed zer nas/ rdo za ba/ chu 'thung ba byed pa yong bar 'dug te/ de la bcud len byas kyang phan med gsung*/ bcud yod pa len dgos/ sha'am chang 'di'i skabs su nyug pa cig gsung*/ des chad pa dpal len dgos gsung*/ bye ma bskal ba'i bar brtsir yang mar khu mi yong gsung*/ nyungs dkar btsir ba las mar khu yong gsung*/ de zas kyi sgrub pa yin/ da grogs kyi sgrub pa la/ pad can ma dang*/ sna tshogs can ma dang*/ ri dwags chad pa ma dang*/ dung can ma dang*/ glang po can ma la sogs pa bshad rgyud mang na yang*/ rab 'bring gsum du 'du/ rab stod mnga' ris lta bu'am mdo smad lta bu na/ phyag rgya ma 'di lta bu yod zer thos pas/ rnal 'byor pa bde ba skyes na rtsar 'gro mi dgos/ de rab yin/ mthong ba rtsam gyis bde ba skye na 'bring yin/ bde ba de rang bskyong ba yin/ tha ma dbang po gnyis sbyor la rten na'u thug pa'i las yin gsung lar dus ngan gyi sems can 'dod chags rgyus gle dogs med nya ra thub pas chog gsung*/ da de ltar bsgrub thabs kyi yan lag lnga la rten nas bsgrubs pas bde ba de nyid skyes pa'i rim pa ngo bo stong nyid dang zung 'jug tu nyams su blangs pas/ tshe gcig lus cig la rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa/

phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyang 'khor lo sgyur ba'i rgyal po ltar 'byung*/ lar thams cad bde ba 'dir rang gi gnad yin gsung*/ chos rje rin po che dang bla ma rngog lo tsa ba/ la da dmar po la sogs pa'i gtam rgyud yang gsum*/ rtsa rlung ma tshar yid kyi sngo ba mdzad/ yang zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos nyan cing nyams su blang nyams su bsam/ de la bshis ngosprod par byed pa'i man ngag dang*/ sems kyi gshis ngo sprod par byed pa'i man ngag gnyis las/ de nas lus kyi bshis ngo sprod par byed pa'i man ngag la gnyis las/ phyi rol ji bzhin nang de bzhin/ bgyi ba yin pas/ phyi rol na ji ltar gnas pa bzhin/ nang rdo rje'i lus la de ltar gnas pa yin/ de la sgal tshigs nyi shu rtsa lnga gzhu gu thung dang rtsa drug /rtag rtsa 'khor dang rtsa bdun brtsegs pa bzhin yod pas phyi rol du ri'i rgyal po ri rab byung*/ nang na gsum pa'i rdzing chen po yod pas phyi chu'i rgya mtsho byung*/ yan lag rnam pa bzhi khrag dang chu ser la sogs 'bab pas na/ gzhan yang rtsa rnams sba'i cho na thag rgyangs pa bzhin yod pas de rnams kyi nang nas chu ser la sogs pa 'bab pas na phyi'i rgya mtsho la chu po chen po bzhi chu g.yog lnga brgya dang bcas pa 'bab pa byung ba kha dang mig la sogs pa nas kha chu 'bab pas na phyi rol du rang gi car cigar la sogs pa byung*/ skra dang smin ma la sogs pa yod pas na phyi rol du nags span spun la sogs pa 'byung*/ de yang rtsa g.yas pa nas khams byang chub kyi thig le dmar po 'bab pa dang*/ phyi rol du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'byung*/ rtsa g.yon pa nas khams byang chub kyi thig le dkar po 'bab pas na/ phyi rol du bya ba'i dal 'byung*/ rtsa dbu ma stong par yod pas na gza' sgra gcan 'dzin yin/ gzhan gza' chen po brgyad dang rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa sgal mchan na yar rtsa 'khyil ba bzhin ba rug ge yod pas phyi rol du skar ma'i tshogs rnams 'byung*/

yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa yod pas na'ang rdo rje'i lus 'di la yod pa yin/ nyi zla gza' 'dzin pa'i rgyu mtshan yang rtsa dbu ma stong par yod par sgra gcan 'dzin yin gsungs pas/ de la rlung sems dbu mar tshud pa'i dus su yang na g.yas na dmar po 'bab 'phro chad/ yang na g.yon nas dkar po 'bab 'phro chad/ dus 'khor la sogs kyang 'di tsa na 'dzin zer ba yod/ de la rnal 'byor pa rlung sems la dbang thob pas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin zer can rtsa g.yas na dmar po 'bab 'phro mchad par sgoms pas mi 'dzin pa thub/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin zer tsa na g.yon nas dkar po 'bab 'phro ma chad par bsgoms pas mi 'dzin pa thub/ chos rje dang slob dpon par+wi pa'i gtam rgyud yang gsung*/ lus kyi gshis ngo sprod par byed pa'i man ngag nyi zla gza' 'dzin dang bcas pa tshar ba yin/ yid kyis sngo ba mdzad/ yang zab pa dang rgya che ba'i= de la sems kyi gshis ngo sprod pa'i man ngag la dge ba la bde ba 'byung ba dang*/ mi dge ba la sdug bsngal 'byung ba la sogs pa sems kyi gshis ma yin/ bzang ngan gyi gshis yin/ sems kyi gshis ni/ de la sems nyid gdod ma nas ma skyes pa skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba de rang yin/ phyag rgya chen po'i ngo sprod mdzad pa de rang yin/ sems kyi gshis ngo sprod par byed pa'i man ngag tshar ba yin/ yid kyis/ yang zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos nyan cing nyams su blang snyam du bsam/ de yang 'khor lo bzhi'i man ngag 'di yang shin tu dgos pa yin/ de la spyir rdo rje'i lus 'di la rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi'i bdag nyid du gnas pa yin/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo// snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor dang bzhi las/ 'dod chags drag po nam skyes pa'i dus su sems kyi rgyal po de lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo na gnas/ de'iganas de nyid yin/

de las 'chug med/ zhe sdang drag po nam skyes pa'i dus su sems kyi rgyal po de snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo na gnas/ de'i gnas de nyid yin/ de las 'chug med/ phrag dog drag po nam skyes pa'i dus su sems kyi rgyal po de mgrin par longs spyod kyi 'khor lo na gnas/ de'i gnas de nyid yin/ de las 'chug med/ gti mug nam skyes pa'i dus su sems kyi rgyal po de spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo na gnas/ de'i gnas ni de nyid yin/ de la lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor 'dod chags nam skyes pa'i dus su g.yas mi 'jur g.yon du mi 'jur bas 'dod chags de nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pas 'dod chags med pa'i stong pa nyid du rtogs 'gro*/ rang gnas snyog pa yin/ rang gnas gang yin na chos thams cad kyi rang gnas stong pa nyid yin pas de ltar rtogs 'gro/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lor zhe sdang nam skyes pa'i dus su yang zhe sdang de nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pas zhe sdang med pa'i stong nyid du rtogs 'gro/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lor phrag dog nam skyes pa'i dus su yang*/ phrag dog de nyid la g.yas su mi 'jur g.yon du mi 'jur bar rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pas phrag dog med pa'i stong pa nyid du rtogs 'gro spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor gti mug nam skyes pa'i dus su g.yas su mi 'jur g.yon du mi 'jur bar rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pas gti mug med pa'i stong pa nyid du rtogs 'gro/ gti mug 'od gsal du 'gyur ba yin/ nyams su len gyi chos thun dang po'o// yid kyi sngo ba cig mdzad/ yang zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos nyan cing nyams su blang snyam du bsam/ de la lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor rtogs pa de la grub thob cig yong ste/ ji lta bu cig yong na slob dpon rgyal po iṇ+d+ra bhu ti lta bu cig yong ste/

de'idus su mi rigs shas che ba dbang du 'du/ mkha' 'gro ma til gyi phung po bzhin du 'du/ rdzas kyi dngos po dag rgu yong bud med rnams kyis za ma drangs/ btung ba rnams rnal 'byor pa la de la 'bul du yong*/ mthong ba tsam gyis mchi ma 'chor ba 'ong*/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi srog gi snying po lags bcangs yin bgyi ba gsung*/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lor yang zhe sdang stong pa nyid du rtogs pa de la grub thob cig yong ste/ ji lta bu gcig yong na slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas lta bu gcig yong ste/ 'di'i dus su mi pho rigs thams cad dbang du 'du/ zhe sdang can rnams kyi srog gi snying po 'chang*/ da lta yang lho nub mtshams na srin po'i kha gnon la bzhugs yod/ grub thob de lta bu cig yod/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo yang phrag dog stong pa nyid du rtogs pa de la grub thob cig yong ste ji lta bu cig yong na/ slob dpon ḍom+bhi he ru ka lta bu cig yong*/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor gti mug stong pa nyid du rtogs pa de la grub thob cig yong te ji lta bu cig yong na/ slob dpon grub bam la ba pa lta bu cig yong*/ gti mug can ji snyed cig yod pa dbang du 'du/ 'khor lo bzhi'i de nyid tshar ba yin/ yid kyis sngo ba re mdzad yang zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos nyan cing nyams su blang snyam du bsam/ de la 'di 'gal med pa sto glun pas na chos 'di chings yin/ de la dang po phyag rgya chen po ngo sprad pas rtse gci gi rnal 'byor rgyud la skye/ de nas spros bral gyi rtogs pa shar ba'i dus su mnyam par bzhag pa dang rjes kyi shes pa gnyis ched du nas yong*/ de'i dus su bcu chos sum chos ran pa yin/ de'i dus su rnam rtog skyes pa thams cad lam tu btong ba nas nyams su blangs pas nyon mongs pa thams cad rtsa ba nas dag nas mnyam par bzhag pa 'ba' zhig tu song na/

zab chos gzhan rnams lhag cing khog na yod pa lta bu yin/ de ma yin pa'i rjes kyi shes pa rtsa ba nas ma dag na sum chos 'khor lo ma ltar rnam par rtog pa ma skyes skye chis byed pa'i ltas spun rtser byung ba'i tshe/ phag sna'i gtun po byas nas sdom pa rnam pa bzhi'am/ phyag rgya bzhis rgyas btab nas nyams su blangs pa rjes shes skyes pa'i tshogs thams cad skye med du rtogs nas zas chos gzhan thams ca lhag cing khog na yod pa lta bu yin/ des kyang rtsa ba nas ma spongs na 'khor lo lngas nyon mongs pa lnga spangs nas dpe gnyis po ltar nyams su blangs pas nyon mongs pa rtsa ba nas dag nas rgyal ba rigs lnga'i yon tan ji snyed yod pa 'byung*/ zab chos gzhan rnams thams cad lhag cing khog na yod par dang 'dra/ des kyang nyon mongs pa rtsa ba nas ma spongs na zab chos rtsa rlung ma'i gshis ngo sprod dam/ 'khor lo bzhi'i de nyid dang bcas pa ltar nyams su spang bya thams cad thabs su byas nas/ shes rab stong pa nyid dang dbyer med du byas nas nyams su blangs pas/ nyon mongs pa thams cad rtsa ba nas dag/ de ma yin pa'i ra zab pa la sgrang ba lta bu'i tig hig cig dgos rgyu med/ rmog la dpe mdzad pa yin/ rnam pa kha kha na le le yod kyang*/ spyi bo nas slog slog cig gis bsdams pa'i dus su/ gcig tu 'gro ba dang 'dra bar 'gal med du ston pa yin/ yid kyi bsngo ba cig mdzad/ yang zab dang rgya che ba'i chos nyan cing nyams su blang snyam du bsam/ de la 'di'ang ltas bltag pa'i rtsa ba yin bgyi ba gsung*/ de la rtsa tshig rnam pa dgu yin/ de la bzang ba'i dus/ ngan pa'i dus/ rtsod pa can gyi dus dang gsum yin/ dal lus kyi spro ba bskyed pa'i dus/ ngag gi spro ba bskyed par byed pa'i dus dang*/ sems can spro ba bskyed par byed pa'i dus dang gsum yin/ de la lus kyi spro ba byed pas ngag gi yang sgo glag gros la sogs pa de tsa na bya/

sems kyi spro ba bskyed de/ sems la bya mi bya snyam pa yod pa de byed par thag bcad nges na spro ba bskyed pa'i dus yin/ de la rlung sna bug g.yas nas rgyu ba'i dus/ sprod pa gcad pas bya bzhag la sogs pa kham che ba de tsa na mi bya/ lus kyi spro ba bcad na ngag gi spro ba bcad la gal che yang de tsa na mi bya'o// sems kyi spros pa bcad la sems la bya mi bya snyam pa de can mi bya/ sems kyi spros bcad/ de la rlung sna bug gnyis ka nas rgyu ba'i dus/ bzang yang mi shes/ ngan yang mi shes/ brtsod pa can gyi dus yin/ de rlung sna bug gnyis nas rgyu ba'i dus su/ bsgo glags la sogs pa blo bur du byed dgos pa byung na/ rngas mtho bar bya/ gzhogs g.yas pa phab/ gru mo g.yas pas nu ma g.yas pa non par bya la/ e na tsam cig bsnyes bsdang bas rlung sna bug g.yon nas yong*/ de rtsa na lus ston pa yin/ de nas yang dgon bla ma ci gnyes mdzad cing*/ rlung ltas brtags bgyi pa gsung*/ yang g.yas nas rgyu ba bzang ba cig las med/ bu mo shes rtse byung nas bu ma byung na/ skyes pa'i sna bu g.yas nas rlung rgyu ba dang sprad na bu 'ong*/ chos rjes kyang rdzang ring mo la gnang bas bu byung 'dug rje mar pa la sogs pa'i gtam rgyud yod/ de rlung ltas brtag pa'i rtsa ba yin/ 'di las chos yang gsung bar 'dug ma sngo ba mdzad/ bcu chos gsum chos/ nyi zla gzas 'dzin/ rlung ltas brtag pa'i rtsa ba/ de tsho la khral zho phyed yin/ gzhan ma chos che ba lnga po la zho re yin/ phyag rten log po yin/ de ltar yon phul bas chos de nyams su len pa'i dus su/ longs spyod kyis mi bslu yin gsung*/ gtam rgyud mgo smos tsam byas pa yin gsung*/ gzhan gsung gyur ru lugs yin/ rgyas pa la bsdus pa/ -ithi/ zab pa'i dam chos tshogs rnams la/ bzod par gsol lo mthol lo bshags/ dge bas byang chub thob par shog dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig// /
maṅga laṃ/// /

༄༅// bla ma rgyud padang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ lnga ldan bsgoms pas nang du nyon mongs pa lnga la 'gro ba'i don bshad/ lnga ldan bsgoms pas phyi'i gdon rigs lnga zhi ba'i don bshad/ lnga ldan bsgoms pas phyi'i mi rigs lnga dbang du 'du ba'i don bshad/ lnga ldan bsgoms pas khyad par gyi lag rjes 'byung tshul ni/ lnga ldan bsgoms pas sku lnga dang ye shes 'tshar tshul ni/ lnga ldan lag rjes nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o/ sems bskyed pa/ zhe sdang la gnad du 'gro/ rgyal 'gong gi gdon zhi bar 'gyur/ mi zhe sdang can dbang du 'du bar 'gyur/ gzhan don 'byung bar nus/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sku thob/ me long lta bu'i ye shes 'char/ rang lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgoms/ 'dod chags la gnad du 'gro/ bsen mo'i gdon zhi/ 'dod chags can dbang du 'du/ snang ba zil gyis mnon nus/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi sku thob/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes 'char/ bla ma'i mos gus sgom pa/ ngargyal la gnad du 'gro/ lha'i bu'i gdon zhi/ nga rgyal can dbang du 'du/ rigs 'dzin cing byin gyis rlob/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sku thob/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes 'char/ phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa/ gti mug la gnad du 'gro/ klu'i gdon zhi/ gti mug can dbang du 'du/ 'khor ba las sgrol nus/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku thob/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes 'char/ gzhan don du bsngo ba bya ba/ phrag dog la gnad du 'gro/ btsan gyi gdon zhi/ phrag dog can dbang du 'du/ dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan du mi 'khyar/ don yod grub pa'i sku thob/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes 'char/ 'di lnga ni lnga ldan gyi rkang grangs yin/ phyir nyon mongs pa lnga skye med du 'gro ba'o/ mi rigs lnga'i don byed pa'o/ lnga ldan gyi nus pa lnga smin pa'o// snod dang mi ldan pa rnams la bla ma'i bka' rgya yod pas shin tu gsang bar bya'o/// /

༄༅// lnga lda shog khra ma'i chos bzhugs so/ ༄༅// na mo gu ru/ bla ma rin po che rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma nā ro pas tai lo pa btsal lugs dang bka' ba spyad lug dang chos gnang lugs ni/ dngos po'i gnas lugs lam dang ni/ 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o// ces lus sems gnyis kyi gnas lugs la/ lam nyams su blangs pas 'bras bu ji ltar 'byung ba'i tshul bya ba de gzhan du gsal lo// nyams myong rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa 'char ba la bcu chos kyi gnad zin ma zin bstan pa ni/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas shor sa bzhir ma shor/ gol sa gsum du gsum drug tu bsdus pa'i chos/ ma gol ba'i sgom de gang yin na bzhag thabs gsum yin gsung*/ so mar bzhag pa/ ma bcos par bzhag*/ lhug par bzhag gsung*/ so ma la rtsa so ma ri so ma/ chu so ma/ ma bcos pa gsum la/ sems phyir yang mi spro/ nang du yang mi bsdu/ sgom du yang mi gzung*/ lhug pa la gsum gyi na/ rang ga/ rang lugs su bzhal la bsgom/ de ltar bsgoms pas/ bzhag sar ltengs ba dang*/ ltengs pa 'byams pa gnyis byung na lhan cig skyes sbyor sgom gsung*/ de ltar bsgoms pas rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa 'char te/ dang po rtse cig de nas spros bral/ de nas ro cig de nas sgom med zhi gnas bying ba/ 'char gsung*/ rgod pa/ dang po rtse gcig nas gang zag gi sgra mi 'jug gsung*/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba nas tshe da ldan pa pa bya bar ming btags/ jo bos skyes bu chung ngun skyes bu 'bring*/ skyes bu chen po bya ba gsung*/ gang ba khams gsum rgyud nyon mongs pas gang ba/ zag pa ngan song gsum du/ gnyis pa rgyud dge bas gang zhig byang chub chen por zag pa'o// gang zag la so so skye bo dang 'phags pa'i gang zag gnyis yin te dang po ni/ ltung ba'o/ rnal 'byor bya ba sems rnal ma la/ chos nyid ma 'byor ba la bya gsung*/ rtse gcig la rtogs pa mi 'dod par nyams su 'dod pa yang yod/

'tshal ba dang 'brug pa gnyis nyams su 'dod/ 'ga' zhing rtogs par 'dod pa yang yod/ rtse gcig rab 'bring gsum du byas nas/ rab spros bral chung ngu*/ 'bring rtse gcig tha ma nyams yin gsung*/ yang chos rje yab sras kyi bzhad pas/ nyams yin bya bar yang mi bzhed/ rtogs pa yin byas na nyams mtho dman chu'i rba rlabs dang 'dra gsung*/ 'o na bzhed pa gang yin snyam na/ sems la ngo bo rang bzhin/ mtshan nyid gsum du yod pas/ rtse gcig gi dus su sems kyi ngo bo stong par rtogs pa yin/ spros bral gyi dus su rang bzhin gsal bar rtogs/ ro gcig dus su mtshan nyid gnyis su med par rtogs pa yin/ rnal 'byor bzhi tshigs bshad ma nas/ rtse gcig dus su/ 'di rnams lugs gcig yin/ dang po rtogs/ rang bzhin gsal bar rtogs pa yin/ spros bral dus su ngo bo skye 'gag spros pa thams cad dang bral bar rtogs/ gnyis pa rtogs/ ro gcig dus su gsum ma gtogs/ gsung ngo*/ de la spros bral rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa cig zhag bdun du ma nyams par bzhag go/ de la nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pas bar ma bcad na nges par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas gsung*/ sangs ma rgyas pa de gang gis lan snyam na/ nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pas bar du bcad pas lan pa yin/ de la 'brug pa la sogs pa 'ga' zhig spros bral rtogs na rtog pa mi skye bar 'dod lo// chos rje yab sras kyi bzhed pa sgom med rtogs kyang rtog pa skye gsung*/ de la bcu chos 'di ston pa'i dus nam yin snyam na/ bcu chos ro gcig rtogs pa'i lag cha yin gsung bas/ ro gcig rtogs pa/ nyung du 'gro/ ro gcig rtogs nas de bas kyang nyung du 'gro/ sgom med rtogs nas rtogs pa rnam lam ran pa yin gsung*/ rtse gcig dang spros bral gyi dus su ting nge 'dzin du 'gyur/ ro gcig gi dus nye bar bsgrub bar du 'gyur/ sgom med kyi dus su yon tan du 'gyur/

de ltar yang dang po ting nge 'dzin du 'gyur/ gnyis pa lam du yon tan 'byung*/ gsum gsung kyang rtogs pa rab 'bring gsum kar skye ba'i dus su dgos gsung*/ na gong nas gong du na 'phar ba yin gsung*/ pa mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub 'byung*/ ces gsungs so// spros bral gyis dus su tshogs pa skyong ba la mi dbang*/ de cis te zhe na mnyam rjes yod pa'o// mnyam bzhag la spros bral yin yang*/ rjes rnam par rtog pa langs pas/ des gzhan gyi skyon spong ba dang*/ yon tan bsgrub par mi nus pa yin/ ranganyid la rjes shes yod pa'i gnad ka yin/ spros bral gyi rtogs pa yod pa'i rnal 'byor pa des bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed/ lus longs spyod la sogs pas mchod/ gnas dben pa ri'am/ gangs sam/ nags khrod du bsgoms pas ro gcig gi rtogs pa 'char te/ dkar dmar rnam pa sna tshogs rnams/ rang gi sems su lhan cig go/ gzung 'dzin gyi rtsa ba sbad kyi chod/ gnyis snang gi 'khrul pa ngang gis zhi/ ces pa/ ro gcig gi rtogs pa skyes nas rnam rtog skye'am mi skye gling langs byung bas/ skye'am mi skye na so so skye bo dang khyad par med par skye gsung*/ rjes la khyad par yod dam med na yod/ so so skye bo'i rtog pa rang rgyud pa yin/ rtogs ldan gyi rtogs pa skyes pa skye med bya ba yin gsung*/ rtog pa rang rgyud pa men gsung*/ da ltar yang*/ gzung 'dzin bag chags sna tshogs rnams/ sgom ro gcig gi dus su lhongs pa yin/ lhongs rgyu gong du song ba yin/ nyon mongs la gab sa med pa yin/ rig pa spyang por 'gyur ba yin/ ces gsungs so// da lta rtogs ldan la nyon mongs pa de mi yong du sha ba la zer te/ de ma yin/ rtogs ldan la yang nyon mongs pa rnam rtog skye/ skye pa de chos nyid phyag rgya chen por ma song bas de lta bu yin/ cig gis chos rje la/ bla ma ldum lta bu la jo mo yod lo byas pas/

jo mo yod kyang chos sku yin gsung lo// rje sgam po pa'i slob ma rnal 'byor chos g.yung gis chags pa spyad zer ba rje sgam po pas gsan pas/ chos g.yung khyod kyis bu med la spyad dam byas pas/ phyag rgya chen po las ma 'das par 'dug zer lo// de man na dpal phag mo gru pa tsam cig yin lo// la stod dmar po la 'dod chags chos skur rtogs pa'i sgom yod lo// bla ma lha bas btsang nas mar byon pas/ la stod dmar po'i dgon pa gzigs su byon pas/ bcu chos kyi gnad 'di yod na grub thob yongs su phebs pa chos rje rin po che lta bu skyon med yon tan rdzogs pa 'byung ba yin gsung*/ khong cig po la gnad 'di med pas grub thob skyon can du gyur pa yin gsung*/ de la bcu chos 'di ya gi sangs rgyas man chod nas/ rtse gcig yan chad la dgos gsung*/ tha na bzo byed pa yan chad la dgos te/ dpal gyi bsam yas brtsigs rtsa na rgyal pos tho rangs skad rings gtang nas/ thams cad kyis gzo bka' rgya can bsgoms shig bya ba'i skad gtong lo/ de yang bcu chos kyi gnad yin gsung*/ sku 'bag gcig 'dug pa la chu rten chen po gcig la phyag gnyis kas 'chang pa cig 'dug lo/ bla ma zhang 'tshal pa la zhe sdang chos skur rtogs pa'i sgom yod lo// lo ras chung pa la gti mug chos kyi skur rtogs pa'i sgom yod lo// ro gcig rtogs pa'i dus su bag chags la gnas sa med pas rgyu 'bras myur ba yin/ bla ma gtum skom grir grongs/ bla ma ltum 'dod chags kyis khyim btsun du gyur/ rje rin po che la rmu gab byung ba yin gsung*/ phyag rgya chen po mi rtogs pa yin kyang*/ da res 'di nas rtogs mi rtogs gcig ston gsung*/ rtogs pa la rab 'bring tha ma gsum/ tha ma la 'dod chags kyi rtog pa gcig skye ba de la gnad kyis ma zin na longs spyod chags can gcig gi dbang du phar 'chor/ zhe sdang gi rtog pa de skyes nas de la gnad kyis ma zin na/

longs spyod dgra la phar 'chor/ gti mug la gnyis rgod pa rnam pa sna tshogs su 'phro ba dang*/ bying ba gti mug gi gnyid gnyis la gnad du ma song na longs spyod sa bdag la 'chor/ de bzhin du nga rgyal dang phrag dog la sogs pa thams cad des 'dre'o// rtogs pa rab la pha rol tu phyin pa drug tshad med pa bzhi/ thos bsam sgom gsum/ byams pa/ snying rje/ byang chub sems/ bla ma'i mos gus yod na phar 'gro/ 'bring po la zhing*/ khang pa/ mkhar/ nyi ma zla ba/ la che ba rtsan dregs pa'i dbang du/ sprin pa la sogs pa'o// sngon la phar 'gro la rgyas par bshad/ de nas tshur 'du rgyas par bshad/ de nas mgo gnyan 'dzin pa rgyas par bshad pa ni/ 'dod chags la sogs pa rnams la gnad du ma song na 'khor du 'dod chags spong mi nus pa chags pa spyod pa 'byung*/ zhe sdang la zhe sdang spong mi nus par 'khor du 'thab mo mod pa 'byung*/ gti mug gis mdze pa'am/ 'dri gnod can 'byung*/ nga rgyal can/ skye sa nga bzang*/ yon tan nga che/ shes rab nga che/ sgom sran nga che snyam pa'i nga rgyal spong mi nus pa chags/ phrag dog spong mi nus pa 'byung ngo*/ rab mos gus can rang la zhu/ mos gus gzhan la byed pa 'byung*/ yang na mos gus gcig po cho ga zer ba'i rigs 'byung*/ byams pa la sems can la byams pa chen pa'i rigs 'byung*/ snying rje la sems can la snying rje ba de'i kha 'dzin pa 'byung*/ byang chub kyi sems des 'dre'o// gnad du song ma song*/ thos pa la thos pa'i kha zin pas sangs rgyas byang chub thob 'dod na/ thos pa mang po'i mi phyi 'brongs/ bya ba yin zer nas kha 'dzin/ slob dpon pa dang thos pa ye chungs yin zer ba byung*/ bsam pa la 'chi ba dang mi rtag pa bsams na mi phan zer ba byung*/ sgom pa des 'dre/ tshul khrims la/ tshul khrims dgos pa yin/ tshul khrims med na rtogs pa mtho yang mi phan zer ba 'byung*/ sbyin pa la/ sbyin pa dgos pa yin/
